title: Remap key doesn't work when input language is not English

status.label: Retest right-Alt mapping across input layouts
status.detail: The report uses PowerToys 0.88.0 and says Right Alt-to-Space works in English but not Ukrainian; a commenter notes Right Alt may emit a different key code by layout.

judgment.rationale: The report says Right Alt-to-Space works with English selected but fails after switching to Ukrainian. A commenter notes that Right Alt may produce a different key code under the selected input language, and the repository has separate handling for Right Alt as AltGr. The report uses PowerToys 0.88.0 and does not provide the exact Windows input-language/layout pair or a current-build test. Ask for those discriminating details before treating the language-dependent behavior as a Keyboard Manager defect.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.88.0 installed from GitHub and remaps Right Alt to Space.
The reporter says the remap works with English selected and stops working with Ukrainian selected; returning to English restores it.
A commenter notes that Right Alt may produce a different key code depending on the selected input language.
The issue has one comment, no assignees, and no current-version confirmation.
KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp explicitly detects Right Alt with left Ctrl as AltGr, and the engine tests cover AltGr state handling; this is related input behavior but does not prove the cause here.
Open issue #3641 concerns remapping AltGr to regular Alt, a different expected behavior and not a confirmed covering fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the mapping still changes behavior on v0.102.3001 and request the exact English and Ukrainian keyboard layouts and what the key-capture UI identifies as Right Alt.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue may depend on AltGr/input-layout key identity, but the current report does not include layout details or a current-build test.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Right Alt remapping across input-language layouts
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Right Alt may be interpreted as AltGr or produce a different virtual-key sequence under the Ukrainian layout, but the issue does not identify the active keyboard layouts or captured event.
plan: Confirm the exact English and Ukrainian keyboard layouts and test the same Right Alt-to-Space mapping on v0.102.3001.
Use the key-capture UI to determine whether the physical key is identified consistently across layouts.
If the mapping fails despite a consistent key event, trace the AltGr/layout handling and add a focused regression test.
verification: Confirm the same physical Right Alt key produces Space with each reported layout on the current build.
Verify other AltGr combinations and ordinary Right Alt shortcuts remain functional.

confidence.rationale: The commenter identifies a plausible layout-dependent key identity, but the report lacks exact layout names and current-build behavior.

inferences: The key may be treated as AltGr or produce a different input event under the Ukrainian layout; the exact layouts and captured event are unknown.
issue_context.analysis: The language correlation and the comment about Right Alt key identity make a layout-specific event difference plausible. Current behavior and exact layouts are needed before deciding whether the issue is a PowerToys defect or expected AltGr semantics.
initial_investigation: Read the full report and sole comment, labels, and assignees.

Since the report is from PowerToys 0.88.0, could you confirm whether this still happens on v0.102.3001? Please include the exact English and Ukrainian keyboard layouts and say what the key-capture UI identifies when you press the same physical Right Alt key in each.
